title: Surreal Green Oracle
description: A surreal composite face merges a green-skinned humanoid with three large orange eyes, a wolf-like canine head on the left, and a cracked celestial orb in the background. The lower portion dissolves into fiery orange and red flames with floating embers, while glowing orbs, vines, and a checkered pattern frame the chaotic scene.
